name: Fortune
title: fortune.app
shortDescription: Fortune is an AI-powered accounting software designed for business decision-makers. It automates essential accounting tasks such as report generation and data reconciliation, allowing users to focus on strategic decision-making. Ideal for small to medium-sized businesses, Fortune helps streamline financial processes without the need for manual intervention, making it easier to manage finances efficiently and effectively.
cons: May not support all international accounting standards
